Working notes for the canary plan (high level):
- Canary infra: 2 dedicated GPU slots in our Dedicated pool, isolated model instance with feature-flag routing.
- Metrics to validate: inference p50/p95/p99, token throughput, KV cache hit rate, and functional correctness on the approved eval set.
- Rollback criteria: if p95 > 600ms for more than 30m OR error rate > 0.8% sustained for 15m, auto-disable canary routing and revert to baseline model.
- Safety checks: canary_safety_checklist.pdf includes rate limits, quota caps, and a manual rollback runbook.
- Staging needs: service account w/ S3 read-only path to sanitized payloads, test JWTs, and a staging DNS endpoint (please request infra tickets by Mar 1).
